title: Sangokushi Koumeiden
overview:
Strategy beyond human wisdom. His name is - the peerless master strategist, Zhuge Kongming.

Kongming, the wise general who used every stratagem and fought to restore the Han royal house - based on the classic "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," his life is vividly portrayed by fusing SLG and RPG. Enjoy the subtleties of tactics and strategy and the dramatic story that unfolds before your eyes.

- Movies are used for the opening, duel scenes, events and more. A star-studded voice cast adds to the sense of presence!
- Kongming's army's many fierce battles, such as the Battle of Red Cliffs and the Northern Expeditions against his archrival Sima Zhongda, are recreated along with events. Depending on your actions, an original story may also unfold.
- About 200 generals appear, each with detailed ability values. Unit attributes have classes set for each lineage, such as cavalry and archers, with 40 types in all. Class-ups and class changes are also possible.
- There are as many as 56 stratagems, and using them skillfully decides your fate. You can also choose a plan of operations before battle, and developments change depending on your choices.

人智を超えた、その知略。かの人の名は――
稀代の名軍師、諸葛孔明。

知謀の限りを尽くし、漢王室の復興をかけて戦う智将・孔明――名著『三国志演義』をもとに、彼の生涯をSLGとRPGを融合させて鮮やかに描き出しました。戦術・戦略の妙味と、眼前に展開するドラマティックな物語をお楽しみください。

●オープニング、一騎討ちシーン、イベント等にムービーを使用。さらに豪華声優陣を起用し臨場感も満点！
●赤壁の戦いや宿敵・司馬仲達と戦った北伐など、孔明軍の激闘の数々をイベントとともに再現。また行動によってはオリジナルストーリーになることも。
●およそ200人の登場武将は、それぞれ詳細な能力値を持つ。部隊属性は、騎兵系や弓兵系などの系統ごとにクラスが設定されており、その数は全40種類。クラスアップやクラスチェンジも可能。
●策略も56種類に及び、巧みに使いこなすことが運命を左右する。また戦闘前に作戦を選ぶこともでき、選択次第で展開は変わってくる。
